# How to Use This Book {.unnumbered}

This is an evolving reference rather than a finished textbook.

Each chapter may contain some or all of the following:

- motivation and guiding questions;
- definitions and notation;
- examples and nonexamples;
- propositions and theorems;
- proofs and proof strategies;
- common errors or misleading intuitions;
- connections with other areas of mathematics;
- pedagogical observations;
- problems and questions for later consideration.
